name: Brasero
summary: Brasero does not accept content generated entirely by LLMs or chatbots, and this ban covers code, documentation, issues and artworks. The only stated exception is using AI purely to translate issue and comment texts into English.

evidence.quote: This project does not allow contributions generated entirely by large languages models (LLMs) and chatbots.

This ban of AI generated content applies to all parts of the projects, including, but not limited to, code, documentation, issues, and artworks. An exception applies for purely translating texts for issues and comments to English.
